description: This file defines API endpoints for managing email alert settings in the litellm project, including retrieving, updating, and resetting email event configurations, with helper functions for database interactions.

methods.name: _get_email_settings
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve email settings from the database, returning a dictionary of event names to boolean flags.

methods.name: _save_email_settings
methods.description: Helper function to save email settings to the database, updating the general_settings configuration.

methods.name: get_email_event_settings
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch all email event settings, returning their enabled/disabled status.

methods.name: update_event_settings
methods.description: API endpoint to update email event settings based on user input.

methods.name: reset_event_settings
methods.description: API endpoint to reset email event settings to default values.
